name: DOCS_RCVD_IMAGING_STUDIES
description: This table contains metadata about imaging studies retrieved from external sources. Each row represents a discrete imaging study received in this document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: STUDY_RESOURCE_IDENT
columns.description: The logical ID of the FHIR ImagingStudy resource.

columns.name: STUDY_LOCAL_UNIQUE_IDENT
columns.description: The locally-assigned unique identifier for the imaging study.

columns.name: DICOM_MANIFEST_CSN_ID
columns.description: The DICOM Manifest contact corresponding to this ImagingStudy resource.

columns.name: STUDY_REMOVED_YN
columns.description: Whether the ImagingStudy is no longer in the received imaging list. Default is 0-No.
